displayDescription: A compressed spark bursts with a shockwave, rises as a raymarched flame, and its smoke branches link three ember nodes into a connected system.
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, effects, voice or lyrics.
limitations: Illustrative procedural volume, not a combustion solver: seeded fBm density advected analytically by time; no fluid simulation or feedback buffers.
Temperature-to-colour ramp (#FFF0BC -> #FFAD42 -> #F05A28 -> #747B86 smoke) is an authored approximation, not measured thermal emission.
Smoke uses single-scattering Beer-Lambert absorption toward one point light with 5 noise-free light steps; no multiple scattering or soot chemistry.
Raymarch bounded to 48 primary steps at 640x360 internal resolution, upscaled to 1280x720; fine detail is softened.
Shockwave radius and debris are staged deterministic uniforms with closed-form ballistic trajectories, not simulated blast physics.
Hearth light spill and flicker are analytic approximations; the smoke-branch 'network' is an authored guide shape inside the volume.
Physically simulated full shots require Blender/Cycles gas simulation with baked frames/volumes; it is unavailable in this environment and reported as missing.
Small tag and caption copy use #F6EFE3 instead of the illustration's #747B86 to keep text contrast at or above 4.5:1 on #101218.
